scientificData.title: NSIDC Sea Ice Index, Version 4 (G02135)
scientificData.definition: Extent is the ocean area with at least 15% sea-ice concentration. Monthly mean extent and daily annual minimum are different statistics.

coastline.title: Natural Earth 1:110m land
coastline.sourceProjection: Geographic longitude/latitude WGS84; projected for display to EPSG:3411

projection.normalizationNote: The official 2021 ZIP uses WGS84 EPSG:3413; its coordinates were converted into the common Hughes 1980 EPSG:3411 projection. All other years use Hughes 1980 directly.

projectionFinding.source: IPCC AR6 Working Group I, Chapter 9
projectionFinding.statement: Across the assessed emissions scenarios, the Arctic is likely to experience at least one practically ice-free September before 2050. Practically ice-free means sea-ice area below one million square kilometres.
